course.title: Professional Ethics
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Examine the following illustration and see if it is the right situation for whistleblowing. (14)

"A young engineer felt that the level of pollutants pouring into the nearby stream from his factory were dangerously high considering the fact that children were swimming down the stream. On informing this to his boss, he was told that his fears were baseless as there had been no complaint from any quarter in the past. What should the engineer do at this stage?".
